name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-40 'Magistrate'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-40 is a full-size semi-automatic pistol chambered in .40 S&W, designed for the licensed enforcement and upscale personal protection market. The frame is machined from a single billet of aerospace-grade aluminum, and the slide features a distinctive angular profile with forward cocking serrations. The trigger is a crisp single-action with a 1.8kg break weight.

Volkov-Saito markets the Magistrate to corponation security directors, licensed bounty enforcement agents, and wealthy individuals who want a sidearm that communicates authority without being ostentatious. The fit and finish are excellent — not decorative, but precisely crafted in a way that rewards close inspection. Every surface is functional, every angle deliberate.

The Magistrate has become the unofficial standard sidearm for mid-level corponation enforcement personnel who have enough rank to choose their own equipment but not enough to access military-grade smart-linked systems. It occupies a comfortable middle ground between the utilitarian Workhorse class and the high-tech weapons of the Spires.
specifications: caliber: .40 S&W effective_range: 50 meters rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic magazine_capacity: 13 rounds weight: 0.92 kg
tactical_use: A precision duty pistol with superior accuracy and ergonomics compared to budget-tier sidearms. The .40 S&W round provides better terminal performance against lightly armored targets than 9mm alternatives. Suitable for aimed fire in deliberate engagements. The single-action trigger rewards trained shooters.
cultural_context: Carrying a Magistrate signals that you are serious, professional, and solvent enough to spend ten times what a Workhorse costs. In Mid and upper-Mid circles, it is a status marker that says 'I handle my own security problems.' Corponation enforcement agents who carry them tend to maintain them meticulously.
story_hooks: A Magistrate with a unique serial number prefix keeps appearing at crime scenes across three districts — registered to a person who has been dead for two years.
A Volkov-Saito factory worker is smuggling out Magistrate frames with a hidden modification that no scanner has detected yet.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.visual_profile: A purposefully austere full-size pistol with aggressive angular geometry — the slide features sharp, forward-raked cocking serrations that catch light dramatically. The frame tapers cleanly from trigger guard to grip, projecting controlled authority rather than flashiness. The overall impression is surgical precision wrapped in gunmetal restraint.
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial but balanced — 0.92kg feels confident in the hand without inducing fatigue, the billet aluminum keeping it lighter than steel competitors while maintaining solid recoil absorption
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade billet aluminum frame with hardened steel slide and match-grade barrel
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal grey with brushed micro-texture, absolutely zero shine — designed to absorb light rather than reflect it. The slide shows intentional tool marks from precision machining, visible under close inspection
physical_description.color_scheme: Cool gunmetal grey as primary; hardened steel slide with faint blue undertones from heat treatment; minimal accent color except functional markings
physical_description.grip_texture: Subtly checkered aluminum grip with fine diamond-pattern knurling — aggressive enough for positive purchase through gloves, restrained enough to appear professional during credential inspections
distinctive_features: Forward cocking serrations arranged in aggressive parallel lines that catch side-lighting
Machining marks deliberately left visible on frame sides — proof of billet-cut precision
Minimalist iron sights with tritium dots (faintly visible as tiny luminous points)
No rail system or accessory mounting — pure function
Ambidextrous slide stop levers integrated flush with frame
Cleanly stamped caliber and model designation on slide
Recessed grip safety with sharp edges for positive disengagement
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VOLKOV-SAITO PRECISION stamped in thin serif font on slide; VS-40 designation and MAGISTRATE engraved in matte finish below ejection port; serial number on frame in microscopic font; manufacturer's mark (stylized VS monogram) on grip side — all markings integrated into the design rather than applied
physical_description.condition_typical: Exceptionally well-maintained — these weapons see regular professional cleaning and inspection. Field-worn examples show subtle erosion of finish on grip corners and rear serrations, but frame and slide remain pristine. Holster wear appears as a faint circular impression on frame side where standard duty rigs contact the weapon
